FEATURE_START_MEMORY.INTENT: Research that starts from living memory and home papers: line questions with weighted versions, one bridge paper asked of the family, a few bounded moves while waiting, and a declared case state at every stop.

FEATURE_RESEARCH_SKILLS.INTENT: Bounded version testing and informed independent checks share a portable method surface.

FEATURE_LINE_PACKET.INTENT: Researchers and checkers recover primary testimony and auditable case decisions from instance data; malformed data arguments report their file and field; editorial completeness is judged by a reader; positive saved searches may support a weak argument without new records. Unknown numeric metadata is allowed; nonfinite values and invalid probabilities are refused. Editorial completeness and drawing-layout domains are not publication requirements.

MODULE_RESEARCH_PACKET.INVARIANT: Research packet selections resolve applied working people and identity successors.

MODULE_RESEARCH_DELIVERY.INVARIANT: Documents attach to working people and resolve merged ids before saving media.

FEATURE_PERSON_CARD.INTENT: A story author recovers a person's nearest family, competing readings, namesakes and local copies through instance-declared collections, including JSONL search coverage, without filtering contrary dates.

FEATURE_SOURCE_SEARCH.INTENT: One host-authorized source query records actual index coverage and keeps unavailable answers distinct from zero. The main research replay command and complete request/capture forms expose the same offline path with actionable refusals.

FEATURE_SEARCH_COVERAGE.INTENT: Existing journals and read records describe individual and surname-place visits, result rows and explicitly established identity separately. Explicit people survive dictionary mismatch; principal identity work precedes repeated searches, while contrary dates and other matches remain visible. Latest source refusal and dubious query semantics stay separate from best outcome. Form annotations, sex and episode, source writing and dated family memory orient planning without changing evidence or life status. Controlled zeros support only against arguments. Repeatable carry-over preserves archives and provenance; FamilySearch channels remain independent.

MODULE_RESEARCH_COVERAGE.INVARIANT: Line fronts follow weighted parent hypotheses from 0.30, match questions by surname or explicit people, and honor the family's preferred line order. The recheck queue puts chosen chains and their ancestors' siblings first, then the secondary scope, then enabled collateral descendants, retaining score order within each group.
